text: Let me tell you what you know about machinery. Maloney, again I say, has your answer back. I have, I say, I have. Well, then why don't you give me some? I'll say that you will don't give me any. Stacy, don't tell us a little bit about your fate with your wife. Sure, man, I had my father long before he was born. Yes, and I suppose that accounts for your fiery temper.
